[**À retenir**]{.encadre-insight-titre}

{{< include _ccom-acp-bilan.md >}}

- **`r aa_n_ind` individus**, `r aa_n_actives` variables actives, k = **`r aa_n_bestk` clusters** (`r aa_t_sizes`)
- **ACP** — Variance 1-2 : `r aa_v_var12` %, 1-3 : `r aa_v_var13` %. `r aa_n_kaiser` axes au-dessus du seuil Kaiser
  - Dim1 (`r aa_v_dim1` %) `r aa_t_dim1`
  - Dim2 (`r aa_v_dim2` %) `r aa_t_dim2`
- **HCPC** — Silhouette **`r aa_v_sil`** (`r aa_t_sil_qual`), `r aa_n_neg` mal classés (`r aa_v_neg_pct` %)
:::

```{r}
#| label: rt-bilan-cards
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

render_cluster_cards(hcpc, indiv_df, ddict = DDICT, actives = rownames(pca$var$coord),
                     cluster_names = cluster_names, cluster_comments = cluster_comments,
                     top_n_para = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: intro-axes-synthese
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

# Lecture des axes — SANS encadré bleu (texte simple, pas d'encadre-insight).
cat("**Comment interpréter les axes de la visualisation des clusters ?**\n\n")
cat("Sur les biplots ci-dessous, **Dim1 = axe horizontal (x)** et **Dim2 = axe vertical (y)** (plan principal) ; le 2ᵉ panneau croise **Dim1 × Dim3**. Un point = un individu, coloré par cluster.\n\n")
for (.i in seq_along(dim_names))
  cat(sprintf("- **Dim%d — %s** : %s\n", .i, dim_names[.i], dim_comments[.i]))
```

```{r}
#| label: plt-clusters-bilan
#| echo: false
#| out-width: !expr if (isTRUE(CONFIG$cluster_plane_13)) "100%" else "72%"
#| fig-width: !expr if (isTRUE(CONFIG$cluster_plane_13)) 14 else 7
#| fig-height: !expr if (isTRUE(CONFIG$cluster_plane_13)) 6 else 6
#| fig-align: center

ind_coords <- pca$ind$coord
.cen <- apply(ind_coords[, 1:3], 2, function(v) tapply(v, hcpc$data.clust$clust, mean))
.qx <- quantile(ind_coords[, 1], c(.02, .98)); .qy <- quantile(c(ind_coords[, 2], ind_coords[, 3]), c(.02, .98))
shared_xlim <- range(c(.qx, .cen[, 1])) * 1.02
shared_ylim <- range(c(.qy, .cen[, 2], .cen[, 3])) * 1.02
p12 <- plot_ind_cluster(pca, hcpc, axes = c(1, 2), label_parangons = TRUE, dim_names = dim_names, cluster_names = cluster_names) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = shared_xlim, ylim = shared_ylim)
combo <- if (isTRUE(CONFIG$cluster_plane_13)) {
  p13 <- plot_ind_cluster(pca, hcpc, axes = c(1, 3), label_parangons = TRUE, dim_names = dim_names, cluster_names = cluster_names) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = shared_xlim, ylim = shared_ylim)
  p12 + p13 + plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect")
} else { p12 + plot_layout(guides = "collect") }
combo +
  plot_annotation(title = sprintf("Typologie des %d clusters", aa_n_bestk),
                  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0.5))) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
